item.title: Cabin 1.09.26.28
item.description:
Cabin 1.09.26.28 — Comfortable at any size

  • Comfortable at any window size — shrink the window and everything reflows instead of overlapping or clipping: a compact header (screen menu + “•••”), single-pane Playlists you can page back from, stacking iPod-sync panes, shrinking drawers/sheets, and slimmer detail headers so lists still fit.
  • More room for lyrics & credits — First Listen’s landscape Lyrics/Credits tabs dock a slim one-row control bar so the words fill the panel.
  • Cleaner playback controls — native volume slider, a distinct draggable timeline handle, larger tap targets and higher-contrast labels.

item.title: Cabin 1.09.26.27
item.description:
Cabin 1.09.26.27 — Responsive player

  • The player fits any window — short-and-wide windows flip Now Playing and First Listen to a two-column layout (cover left, controls right); nothing clips and everything scales as you resize.
  • More control over the slowed sound — the FX menu’s Slowed + reverb section adds a Speed dial and a Reset that clears speed, pitch and reverb together; cleaner sliders and a tidied-up card.
  • See what friends just added — a friend’s collection now groups “Recently added” at the top.

item.title: Cabin 1.09.26.26
item.description:
Yoin is now Cabin

Same app, warmer name — the intimate room where it’s just you and the record. Your library, downloads and settings are unchanged.

  • Room & vinyl effects — Through a Wall, Boombox, Old Radio, Basement Show, Tube Warmth, Living Room — with an Amount dial. Stacks on the EQ and the vinyl crackle.
  • Tape wow & flutter — Worn Tape and Warped Cassette presets for that warped-cassette pitch wobble.
  • Effects from anywhere — right-click the player on any Now Playing screen, hover a preset to audition it live, and dial the Amount. Now applies to imported and downloaded songs too, not just streams.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.25
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.25 — Room, vinyl & tape effects

  • Room & vinyl effects — a new FX menu reshapes the space your music plays in — Through a Wall, Boombox, Old Radio, Basement Show and more — with an Amount dial to set how strong. It stacks on top of the EQ and the vinyl crackle.
  • Tape wow & flutter — two new presets, Worn Tape and Warped Cassette, add that warped-cassette pitch wobble for a worn, analog warmth.
  • Tune effects from anywhere — right-click the player on any Now Playing screen to reach the effects, and hover a preset to audition it live before you commit.
  • Effects on every track — the room, EQ and vinyl effects now apply to imported and downloaded songs too, not just streams.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.24
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.24 — Records you don't own, told properly

  • A page for records you don't own — click a wishlist album, or a friend's pick, to open a full page: the cover, a streamable tracklist, artist & album info, and a Buy on Bandcamp button — instead of it just starting to play.
  • Friends open instantly — and show what's new — the friends list and their collections are remembered, so the drawer opens with no wait, and a dot on a friend plus NEW tags on their albums show what they've added since you last looked.
  • Every album gets its story — First Listen's About panel now finds an album description from Wikipedia (or Genius) when there's none from Bandcamp — so records like Yeezus aren't blank — and lists the full tracklist beneath it.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.23
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.23 — Playback fixes & First Listen polish

  • Playback that never gets stuck — downloaded albums that could freeze at the very start of a track now play through reliably, and a track that genuinely can’t be played is skipped instead of stalling the player.
  • First Listen names the record — the focused player now shows the album above the track and artist, so you always know which record you’re hearing, with the mode label moved up out of the way.
  • Favourite & thank, from the ceremony — when a new record finishes its First Listen you can favourite the album and thank the artist on Bandcamp right there — and the new-arrival card now shows the album’s real length.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.22
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.22 — First Listen, at any size

  • First Listen, at any size — the focused player now flows with the window: the lyrics and credits panels shrink and tuck away as you narrow it, and the cover always stays perfectly centred.
  • A cover-only mini — shrink the window right down and First Listen becomes just the artwork, edge to edge; play, skip and the timeline fade in over the cover when you point at it.
  • Tidier panels & entry points — side panels sit centred in their space, the record icon is consistent everywhere, and First Listen is offered on records you haven’t really heard yet.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.21
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.21 — First Listen

  • First Listen — meet a new record properly: a focused full-screen player with the tracklist as a dial you can scrub, synced lyrics, and the album’s story — about the artist, liner notes and credits — a tap away.
  • New arrivals shelf — a new “New” filter gathers the albums you bought in the last month and haven’t heard yet, so nothing you buy slips through.
  • Know your records — artist bios and real track credits (producers, players, engineers) now show right inside the app.
  • A warmer welcome — a friendlier first run when you haven’t connected an account yet.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.20
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.20 — Faster & smoother

  • Faster & smoother — the Now Playing, Art mode and iPod screens no longer redraw many times a second while music plays. Noticeably lighter and smoother, especially over long sessions.
  • Snappier library — your crate scrolls smoother, and the budget slider in Prep for trip no longer stutters as you drag it.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.19
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.19 — Trip prep, managed

  • Trip prep knows you’re ready — once you’ve downloaded a batch, Prep for trip tells you you’re trip-ready and how much is saved, instead of endlessly offering another 40.
  • Manage your offline batch — a new gliding control lets you add new albums, refresh the ones you’ve saved, or delete them to reclaim space, from Settings ▸ Offline & travel.
  • Smoother by feel — fluid, Apple-style motion on the trip controls, with clearer hover and click cues.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.18
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.18 — Friends who own it

  • Friends who own it — see which of the people you follow already own a record. A little badge now appears on covers across your crate, on album pages and the collection map — and it’s cached, so it’s there the moment you launch.
  • Faster album pages — tracklists are remembered after the first look, so reopening an album you’ve already browsed is instant, with no waiting on a fresh fetch.
  • Lighter & tidier — a leaner build with cleaned-up theming and small fixes across the player, settings and share card.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.17
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.17 — Offline & travel

  • Prep for trip — one tap fills your player for a flight or train. Set an album budget and Yoin downloads a mix of your most-played, recently-played and a few records you’ve never heard, all in FLAC. In Settings ▸ Offline & travel.
  • Knows when you’re offline — Yoin watches your real connection. Lose Wi-Fi and an “Offline” badge appears in the top bar; tap it to jump straight to your downloaded albums.
  • Covers that work offline — downloaded albums now keep their artwork on your Mac, so your crate looks right with no connection — no more blank grey covers on the plane.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.16
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.16 — iPod, leveled up

  • A real iPod menu — the Classic replica now has a working click-wheel menu (Music ▸ Artists / Albums / Songs, Cover Flow, Now Playing). Spin the wheel to scroll with the classic click, press to play.
  • Make it yours — choose your iPod’s finish (black, silver, blue or (PRODUCT)RED) in Settings, now with proper metal shading.
  • Know your iPod — right-click the iPod header for a Library ⇆ iPod diff, an iPod recap (top artists, most-played), and to import your device’s play counts into Yoin’s history and recap.
  • Smoother all round — accurate cover matching (no more wrong art), one-tap eject and ghost-track cleanup, auto-detect without opening Apple Music, and a loading indicator when your recap builds its mix.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.15
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.15

  • Your iPod, in Cover Flow — plug in a click-wheel iPod and open it straight from the top bar. Browse it as a pixel-faithful black iPod Classic with a real, working Cover Flow and click wheel — and it plays your iPod’s own tracks.
  • Drag music on and off — your library sits right beside the iPod: drag an album on to add it, or drag a cover off to import it into Yoin, with live transfer progress. Right-click for Download or Add to iPod.
  • Plug and play — Yoin now finds your iPod over USB on its own, without opening Apple Music first, and there’s a proper eject button for when you’re done.
  • Smoother syncing — covers are cached across the whole iPod view, so browsing and Sync mode stay fast even with a big library.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.14
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.14

  • Your year, in covers — the recap is now a full year-in-review: minutes played, new discoveries, longest streak, a listening persona, top genres, month-by-month covers, and the countries your artists come from. Pick any year you’ve been listening.
  • Who you backed — the artists and labels you supported, plus how much of your listening is music you actually own — bought on Bandcamp, straight to the artists — with a wishlist nudge to keep it going.
  • Save the year as a playlist — play a mix of the tracks you played most, then save your year as an editable playlist.
  • How you listened to each album — tap any cover for your favourite track, busiest month, per-album streak, and when you first heard it.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.13
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.13

  • Menu-bar mini player — a now-playing card drops down from the menu bar so you can see the current track and control playback without leaving what you’re doing. Turn it on in Settings.
  • Restore removed albums — pick exactly which removed albums to bring back into your collection instead of restoring the whole hidden set at once.
  • Right-sized on your Mac — Yoin scales itself to your display so the interface reads at a comfortable density on a laptop; external monitors stay as they were.
  • Covers that fit the window — the library and wishlist grids resize their covers to the space they have, so a narrow window keeps several covers instead of one giant one.
  • Radio by place — start an endless station from anywhere on your collection map, with “by place” suggestions each carrying their own procedural night-city skyline.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.10
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.10

  • Slowed + reverb — the turntable speed fader grows into a full slowed-and-reverb engine (extra pitch shift, reverb tail and presets), reachable from a new FX pill under Now Playing and from Settings.
  • Fits any window — Yoin shrinks gracefully to a tiny window: the crate reflows into a carousel, coverflow or single focused cover, and the player bar pares down to just what fits.
  • Straight to the map — tap an album’s origin on its page to fly the collection map to that place; artist locations now read straight from Bandcamp.
  • A tidier map — nearby cities cluster into region bubbles at low zoom and split apart as you zoom in; the Friends map shows purchases only.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.9
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.9

  • Lyrics stay put — synced lyrics stay open as the track changes instead of collapsing every song; they fall back to the disc only when a track has none.
  • A fresh look — a new app icon, and the mini, vinyl and bar players now always show the album and artwork of what’s actually playing.
  • Steadier under the hood — more robust Bandcamp collection reading, backed by the app’s first automated tests.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.8
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.8

  • Map owned, wishlist & friends — the collection map now switches between your library, your wishlist, and your friends' music. Friends' pins show their profile pictures, and a chevron opens the full album list, grouped by friend.
  • Faster pins — locations resolve progressively, so the map fills in right away instead of after a long wait, with a live loading indicator.
  • Buy from the map — records you don't own show a Buy on Bandcamp button, so supporting an artist is one click away.
  • Keyboard navigation — flip through the crate with the ← and → arrow keys, and press ⌘S anywhere to open search like Spotlight.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.7
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.7

  • Livelier collection map — the map now responds as you move around it: pins grow and brighten under the cursor, album rows and the Top Country tile highlight on hover, and every control shows the pointing-hand cursor.
  • Also in this line — time-synced lyrics, the collection map, and living cover art (new in 1.09.26.6).

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.6
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.6

  • Time-synced lyrics — Now Playing can show scrolling, line-by-line lyrics that follow the music. Tap the lyrics button to swap the disc for the words; enable it in Settings.
  • Collection map — see where your music comes from: a world map plots each artist's home town, with a new Top Country tile in your listening stats. Tap a pin to browse the albums from there.
  • Living cover art — album art in Now Playing gently comes alive, and the artwork backdrop across the app is smoother and lighter on your Mac.
  • Fixes — sturdier artist-location lookup (quoted or unusual names, and cancelled requests, no longer get stuck as permanent misses), and lyrics no longer carry over to the next track.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.5
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.5

  • Nothing overlaps the player — the Crate's filter list and album details no longer spill over the playback bar in smaller windows, and the window now keeps a comfortable minimum height so everything stays readable.
  • Clearer crate — records receding into the crate now dim with depth, so the now-playing title and filter list beside them stay easy to read, even behind bright covers.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.4
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.4

  • Faster, smoother everywhere — a deep performance pass: the moving playhead no longer re-renders the whole window, your library saves in the background instead of hitching the UI, big lists and album lookups are cached, and cover colours are analysed off the main thread. The app stays responsive even mid-sync.
  • Saved stations get covers — your saved radio stations now show real album art: the matching record for album and artist stations, and a signature gradient for moods.
  • Cleaner EQ — dragging the equalizer faders no longer clicks or glitches; the filter now rebuilds off the audio thread, so tweaks are smooth while the music keeps playing.
  • Snappier search — the ⌘K command palette is quicker: searches are debounced and your albums are pre-indexed, so results keep up as you type.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.3
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.3

  • Turntable mode — the Now Playing disc becomes a record on a platter: vinyl wear that deepens with play count, faint analog surface crackle, and a 33/45/78 speed switch that shrinks the record to a single and repitches the track like a real deck.
  • Much smoother player — the turntable and disc screens are far lighter on the CPU: cover art is decoded once and reused, the record face is cached, surface effects are throttled, and the crackle loop loads off the main thread — so playback controls stay instantly responsive.
  • Record condition — album pages now show how many times you’ve played a record and grade its condition from Mint to Well-loved.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26.2
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26.2

  • Seamless transitions — tracks blend with an equal-power crossfade, and Beat-match eases their tempos together (pitch preserved) on owned files. Auto-DJ turns radio into one continuous mix.
  • Equalizer — a 10-band graphic EQ with presets (Rock, Vocal, Bass Boost, Loudness…) and a drag-to-tune Custom curve.
  • Real waveforms — the player bar shows each track’s actual waveform for owned files.
  • Monthly recap card — a shareable summary of your month (top artist, minutes, most-played), shown once a month and re-openable from that month’s playlist.
  • Command palette & menu bar — ⌘K to search and run anything, a now-playing menu-bar item, and space-bar play/pause. Plus Shortcuts & AppleScript actions.
  • More to discover — Bandcamp Friday flags on the wishlist, “more from this artist” on album pages, buy links for anything you don’t own, vinyl play-count patina, tempo smart shelves, and smoother trackpad-friendly controls.

item.title: Yoin 1.09.26
item.description:
Yoin 1.09.26

  • Radio & “Made for you” mixes — endless radio over your own collection, plus personalised mixes from your most-played artists (a fresh set each day) and one-tap artist/album stations you can save.
  • Classic iPod sync — browse a connected click-wheel iPod covers-first, and drag albums on and off the device in the split Sync view.
  • Wishlist tab, shareable Now-Playing card, AirPlay & output devices, Liked Songs & smart playlists, ambient theming, Art Mode, mini players, turntable scratch, music credits and a library-health scan.
  • Better imports (genres from your files & Bandcamp, reliable covers), plus a reliability & accessibility pass.

item.title: Yoin 1.2.0
item.description:
Yoin 1.2.0

  • Radio — endless stations from your own collection: start one from a mood, an artist, or any album, switch mood picks between Local and Online (Last.fm), and save your favourites in the new Radio tab.
  • Smart playlists — auto-updating “Rarely played” and “Best of” any month or year.
  • Liked songs — heart individual tracks and find them in the Liked Songs list; every track row gains quick like & more actions.
  • Smoother & steadier — a loading screen while your collection syncs, snappier playback and history, and fixes so a stalled stream or a stuck menu can never freeze the app.

item.title: Yoin 1.1.1
item.description:
Yoin 1.1.1

  • Fixes a crash that could occur when a track with cover art started playing (system Now Playing / media keys).
  • Includes everything from 1.1.0: playlists & a live queue, media keys & Now Playing, and the listening-stats card.

item.title: Yoin 1.1.0
item.description:
Yoin 1.1.0

  • Playlists & a live "Up Next" queue — build playlists, drag to reorder, play next / add to queue, and give each playlist its own cropped cover.
  • Media keys & system Now Playing — control Yoin from your keyboard, Control Center, AirPods, and the lock screen, with cover art.
  • Listening stats in Settings — top artist (tap to flip for your most-played track), top genres, and an 18-week heatmap.

item.title: Yoin 1.0.2
item.description:
Yoin 1.0.2

  • New app icon — a 70's vintage gold vinyl, now full-bleed so it sits right in the macOS Tahoe Dock.
  • A "What's New" screen after each update, re-openable any time from Settings ▸ About.

item.title: Yoin 1.0.1
item.description:
Yoin 1.0.1

  • New app icon — 70's vintage gold vinyl.

item.title: Yoin 1.0
item.description:
Yoin 1.0

  • Connect your Bandcamp account, play and download your own collection.
  • Year-end recap and shareable top-10.
  • Automatic updates via Sparkle.
